design: Full H792 factorial, L1 native source-output swaps. At L2 second-source attention output and/or query MLP output, clamp joint-state output to stored z_a0+z_0b-z_00. No clamp arm replays H792. All16factorial cells and all four arms retained.
prediction: Removing second-source L2 attention interaction reduces final candidate interaction more than removing early query-local MLP interaction if the traced source route is relevant.
limitations: Additive output clamps are hybrid causal tests, not unique mediation fractions. Joint arm clamps query MLP to original reference additive prediction, not a recomputed prediction after source clamp. Other token positions/paths live. Reused localization panel.
